description: The side panel's Signal page: the names in Claude's replies, looked up.

messages.search_again: Search again for the names not found
messages.empty: No names yet: the files, commits, env vars and routes in Claude's replies show up here.
messages.reader_tip: The reader: a model session reads the chat in order, like a person following along (your messages, what Claude ran and saw, its replies), and decides what each name points at in each reply, with Signal's lookups as its tools; its spending is capped and shown in the status line
messages.lsp_tip: Language servers: pyright and typescript-language-server say which definition a code name means (whose field previous.job_id is). Baude fetches them once with npm, at pinned versions, and runs them read-only
messages.tools_tip: Tool schemas: when a reply talks about a tool (the Agent tool, Read), show what it takes, from Anthropic's Agent SDK types and the Claude Code docs (fetched once per Claude Code version)
messages.off: Signal is off. Turned on (here, or with the link button in the header), the files, code, commits, env vars, routes, Kubernetes objects and tools Claude names become links, listed here.
messages.not_running: Not running: the links are what needs no model (the glossary's, the catalogue's and git's: {$n} names)
messages.refresh_tip: Search again, ignoring what was found or given up on
messages.show_in_git_tip: Its place in the history, on the Git page
messages.status_stale: Stale: the code changed and this couldn't be found again. It can still be opened as it was.
